# Muscle_Joint_Moments

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Muscle_Joint_Moments

Computed intact-cat forward results. The columns and named arrays below describe the simulated quantities. [Simulation results](../simulation_report.md).

- [individual_contributions.npz](individual_contributions.npz) — Each muscle’s generalized force contribution from its tendon tension and transmission geometry. Rotational contributions are moments in N m.
- [summed_muscle_generalized_forces.csv](summed_muscle_generalized_forces.csv) — Sum of all muscle contributions at each coordinate. These exclude contact and passive joint contributions, so they are not total inverse-dynamics moments.
